messages:
Alice: Hi! first day and trying to find the onboarding checklist + templates. I can view Company Handbook but not the team-runbooks. Where do people keep the latest templates?
Tom: Welcome :wave: We keep them under Engineering -> Playbooks -> Templates in Notion. Some teams also duplicate a copy into Team Space / Docs.
Alice: I can see Playbooks but the Templates page says 'restricted'. How do I request edit?
Devex Bot: Use the Request Docs Access form: https://forms.redwood.internal/docs-access. Include the page URL and role (viewer/editor). That auto-notifies devex and suggests owners.
Priya: If you need to edit a template, duplicate it to your team space first. For canonical edits, open a comment on the template and tag the owner or request edit rights via the form.
Alice: Any conventions for naming copies? I don't want to create duplicates that confuse search.
Tom: Naming pattern: "Team / Component - DocType - ShortTitle". Add properties: Owner, Status(draft|stable), TemplateVersion.
Alice: Cool. Also, who manages the onboarding checklist itself?
Priya: I own the onboarding checklist for infra. Ping me and I'll add you as editor. We prefer review comments before changing the canonical checklist.
Alice: Thanks all! I filed the form and pinged @Priya.
Priya: Welcome aboard Alice. Happy to pair for 10m to walk through permissions and setting watchers. :smile:
